why.heading: Why work with a developer in 2026?
why.intro: AI can spin up a site in minutes. Here's what it still can't do.
bullets: A site built around your business, not a template forced to fit it.
Code you own outright — no subscription, no lock-in.
Fast, accessible, and built to actually rank — not just look good in a demo.
A real person to call when something needs to change.
Someone who sticks around after launch, not just for the sale.

about.title: About
about.description: Wellington web developer with a lifelong eye for design, now building websites for local businesses.
about.heading: About me
about.photoAlt: Gemma, the developer behind Past Nine
paragraphs: I'm Gemma — three years into building websites professionally, but I've had an eye for design since my Bebo days, endlessly tweaking layouts and profile skins.
Before code, I ran social media for local sports teams, learning how to grab attention and tell a story people actually stop for.
These days I build for small, local businesses — because a considered web presence shouldn't be reserved for the big guys.
